Jake —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few asks from our side to keep the procurement path clean:

- Confirm whether the broker can provide an ACORD COI plus an endorsement naming Redwood as Additional Insured with the following language: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are included as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the operations of the named insured."
- Primary/non-contributory: carrier must confirm the policy will be primary and non-contributory relative to Redwood's coverage.
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood for the duration of the Order Form term.
- Aggregate: our standard is $2M per aggregate or otherwise show carrier capacity to meet combined limits — if they cannot split, we need a carrier letter.

Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Aditya (sales ops) to confirm precise entity/address and any further legal constraints.

Soojin / Aditya —

Thanks for the context. Quick legal guidance and recommended language below (sending COI template and one-pager as attachments):

- Additional Insured endorsement: we request either ISO CG 20 10 11 85 or equivalent wording. Redlined sample: "The insurer shall endorse Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates, and each of their officers, directors, employees and agents as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the named insured's work under the Agreement."
- Primary/non-contributory: "Coverage afforded to Redwood Inference, Inc. shall be primary and non-contributory to any insurance maintained by Redwood."
- Waiver of subrogation: include waiver in favor of Redwood where permitted by law.
- Aggregate limits: if the commercial general liability policy shows a general aggregate that is not specifically applicable to the contract, request either a split aggregate or a carrier letter confirming available limits for the project.

If the broker cannot provide an endorsement, request a carrier letter on insurer letterhead explaining why and confirming that coverage meets the economic equivalent.

Attached: Insurance_Requirements_Summary.pdf; COI_Template.pdf

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
